slides.title: A buildup from Adwa
slides.body: ACLED says large numbers of federal troops and equipment were seen moving from Adwa toward Rama on Nov 5 and 6. Local sources placed Tigray forces (TDF) in and around the town.

slides.title: from the Mereb River border
slides.body: Rama sits near Eritrea. Per ACLED, it has changed hands since federal forces took it on Oct 14.

slides.title: civilians reportedly killed on Oct 30
slides.body: ACLED says a drone strike believed to be by the ENDF hit a civilian truck in Rama town.

slides.title: Protect civilians in Rama and across Tigray.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
